plan.estimand: One-group repeated-measures within-time omnibus effect (3 time points)
plan.hypothesis: H₀: μ₁ = μ₂ = μ₃ (no change across time points)
assumptions: Compound symmetry correlation structure (constant correlation 0.5 between all time points)
Univariate F test with sphericity correction (epsilon = 1, no correction needed)
Partial eta-squared effect size of 0.08 (population parameter before correlation adjustment)
scientific_notes: Effect size conversion: partial eta-squared = 0.08 → f-squared = eta-squared / (1 - eta-squared) = 0.08 / 0.92 ≈ 0.0870
Compound symmetry (CS) correlation 0.5 reduces effective degrees of freedom relative to independence
Sphericity epsilon = 1.0 indicates perfect sphericity; no Greenhouse-Geisser or Huynh-Feldt adjustment needed
This is a one-group design (no between-subjects factor); power analysis addresses within-subject repeated-measures effect
